question: Which vidyā is said to be the supreme awakener at the end of the root, O supreme Goddess?
premises: A placement at the end of the root is specified.
A vidyā is identified as the supreme awakener.
inference: At the end of the root, the vidyā should be the supreme awakener.
uncertainties: The referent of mūla is not explicitly defined in this verse.
plain_english: O supreme Goddess, at the end of the root the vidyā is the supreme awakener.
